# Epic to board mapping

Kickoff section 2B sorted the product into three bands on a wall of sticky
notes. This page records what that workshop decided, lists the stickies band
by band, and then maps every backlog epic to its band and its Jira key.

The band is not decoration. It is the filing order into Jira and the order the
work gets built in, because feature work is serial behind one iOS engineer.
Green first, then orange, then gray.

![Kickoff 2B board, Design plus Core Features](/assets/backlog/kickoff-2b-core-features.png)

The kickoff 2B board, Design plus Core Features.

## What the workshop decided

Four decisions came out of 2B.

**The locked backlog is Shape's output, not the workshop's.** The wall set
direction. The 18 epics and 112 features in [the backlog](/backlog-epics) are
the worked version of that direction, and where the two disagree this page
says so rather than quietly picking one.

**Three bands, and the order is the decision.** Green carries the daily loop
and is what has to exist. Orange is the real conversation about what earns a
sprint slot. Gray has a later home and nothing in it is dropped.

**Capacity is the constraint that makes the order matter.** Roughly 21
person-weeks across the three build sprints, about seven per sprint, and
feature work is serial behind one iOS engineer. The order decides what exists
at week eight.

**Design gates the iOS lane.** New user flows, including onboarding and the
invited-to-a-wall path, are known new design work, and the iOS work depends on
receiving them.

## Green, carries the daily loop

The band that has to exist for the product to work at all.

- Cloud foundation (AWS, CI/CD, data model)
- Auth
- Onboarding, and the invited or new user path
- Daily prompt, curated
- Drawing and submit, with submit-to-unlock
- Walls and channels
- Analytics instrumentation, instrument now and report later

## Orange, the real conversation about what earns a sprint slot

- Push notifications, the daily nudge
- Moderation, fail-safe
- Streaks and progression
- Sharing personal
- Reactions

## Gray, outside these eight weeks, each with a later home

- Monetization
- App Store readiness and compliance, at the release phase
- re:Invent event wall, its own scope and funding call
- Under-13 and the COPPA Family edition, after launch planning
- Picking multiple pictures and grouping them
- Comments, with toggles for wall creators and possible AI moderation

## The epics, their band, and their Jira keys

Filed on the Jira project SCRIBL. Epics carry their band as a label, so
`SPRINT0`, `GREEN`, `ORANGE` and `GRAY` are the filters on the board. Parked
is a status on a feature, not a band.

| Epic | Band | Jira key | Features filed | Sticky it covers |

E00 is the one row with no backing entry in `tracking/backlog-epics.md`. The
Shape window and its fifteen spikes exist only in the merged plan, and the
spikes are filed as issue type Spike rather than Story because a spike is done
when its artifact exists rather than when a screen works. It sits first in the
table because it runs first, 2026-08-24 to 2026-09-01, before sprint 1 starts.
See [Sprint 0](/sprint-zero).

**The filed tranche is now a subset, and the totals moved under it.** 63 of the
127 items are filed on SCRIBL, all of them from the 2026-08-25 fetch in
`scripts/data/jira-scribl.json`. Four epics grew after that fetch, when the
screen-by-screen pass over the 28 prototype pages promoted 25 new features:
E02 went to 15, E03 to 9, E04 to 10 and E05 to 13, and E18 to 3. The filed
column is what exists in Jira, the total is what exists in the backlog, and
the gap is the re-file that has not happened. Nothing has been unfiled.

## Where the board and the backlog disagree

**E08 Analytics instrumentation.** The sticky sits in the green core band and
the backlog had it ORANGE. Resolved on 2026-08-24 in favour of the board. E08
and its four features are GREEN and filed in the first tranche. Instrumenting
late means the first two months of behaviour are gone permanently, which is
the argument the wall was making.

**Reactions is an orange sticky and a green feature.** It is E05-F6, reactions
post-unlock only, `band: GREEN` inside E05. The "Sharing personal" sticky is
its own epic now, E12, and is not E05-F3: multi-channel posting puts one
submission on several walls, which is not the same act as producing a file and
sending it somewhere. So E05 is not a single-band epic, and
filing it as flat green promotes it. It is filed as GREEN on SCRIBL-53.
Re-point or re-band it at sprint 1 planning if the wall was right.

**Three gray stickies had no home in the backlog. Now two of the three do.**
Monetization is E17, gray, opened 2026-08-25. Comments with wall-creator
toggles plus AI moderation is E13, opened the same day and put in orange,
because the session decided commenting should be plannable rather than
parked. Neither is filed in Jira yet. Picking multiple pictures and grouping them is
not an epic of its own. It is E12-F2, the deferred extension of E12 Sharing a
response, and a wall, as a document, and it stays gray while E12-F1 through
E12-F4 sit orange.

**E03 needs no reconciliation.** The sticky strikes out "(Claude)" and the
epic already records the kickoff decision that prompts stay curated by the
program team, with Claude scoped to drafting suggestions for editorial review.
E03-F4 carries that.

**E06 and E07 will never map.** Both were added after the wall and the backlog
flags them as such. They are green enabling work rather than board items, so
the wall is not a complete backlog and should not be read as one.
